prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / camera redesign. Create ONE finished portrait 2:3 GAMEPLAY-VIEW STREET CORNER CONCEPT, NO UI. Image 1 is the user's city-region concept: extract its complete coherent scene relationships and urban character into a SMALL representative street corner, not the entire city. Image 2 is the approved painting/material/color reference ONLY; ignore all its UI and use a MUCH HIGHER CAMERA than it. This is a visual camera concept, not a literal map or a composited screenshot.
CRITICAL CAMERA: strict ORTHOGRAPHIC view looking DOWN at 62.5 degrees ABOVE THE HORIZONTAL GROUND, plan azimuth 45 degrees. This is substantially more overhead than usual low isometric art. Broad roofs and ground plots are clearly visible, vertical facades are short in screen height. Projected ground-axis edge slopes are +/-sin(62.5deg)=+/-0.887, so roads/roof edges make about +/-41.6 degrees to screen horizontal, NOT +/-62.5 degrees. Parallel edges do not converge. Vertical walls stay vertical. Do not revert to 25-35-degree low street camera.
SCENE: a single four-way small-city intersection with continuous roads extending off-frame, four complete designed street-front parcels, about 6 buildings total using 3-4-storey warm ivory mixed-use apartments, small cafe and glass-front shops, no building taller than about 10-12 metres. Every visible main door faces its nearby street or clear connected entry court. Keep building walls about 6-10m BACK FROM THE CARRIAGEWAY KERB, filled meaningfully with narrow pedestrian paving, entrances, small brick forecourts and modest planting, not large empty plazas. Roads are about 8m wide. Preserve a CONTINUOUS CLEAR VISIBLE CENTRAL DRIVING CORRIDOR through every road and turn: no roof, awning, tree crown or other object overlaps the central lane in the final screen projection. No overhanging bridges or tall towers. The scene is an ordinary inhabited town, no isolated floating model/base slab.
GROUND: visibly different natural asphalt, light cream sidewalk slabs, fine taupe entry bricks, kerbs, a few drains and legible modest white junction markings. Around 6 modest street trees, each with a visible earthy soil/short grass planting pool and low stone edging; small sections of low fence only where appropriate. Ground greenery stays restrained, roofs have NO trees. Entrances, walls, tree roots, pools and pavements meet naturally, never objects pasted onto one universal tile.
DYNAMIC-SCALE DEMONSTRATION: ONE clearly readable orange delivery rider on a compact orange delivery scooter with a round headlight and orange rear delivery box, riding near the middle of the foreground road, fully unobscured. Readable scale like the approved reference; helmet/body/scooter silhouette must be visible from this higher camera. This is only a representative painted demonstration in the concept; no duplicate riders or UI marker. Avoid small decorative toy-sized rider.
STYLE: bright refined Japanese urban anime painted architecture, rich but controlled material detail, warm off-white stone, subtle pale-grey plaster, blue-grey reflective glass without adding a blue cast, restrained orange awnings, convincing window recesses, varied but coherent buildings. Fixed warm screen-upper-left daylight, clear coherent soft right/down cast shadows and contact shadows, no night/day transition. Carefully composed full ground scenes like the user's reference. No low-poly plastic look, no thick cartoon outlines, no photoreal photograph, no text/logo/watermark, no UI. Show the useful street environment at mobile-game reading distance rather than a whole county miniature.
observations: Complete composed street-corner concept with different road/paving/tree-pool surfaces and a visible foreground delivery rider.
Some drawn building perspective and scale may differ locally; target prompt angle is not a calibrated measurement.
Baked representative rider belongs to concept only; runtime rider remains separate.
No original-road coordinate correspondences, no engine integration, no game tests or user art acceptance.
